Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The MyThread class extends java.lang.Thread but does not override the run method. Consequently, starting the thread does not perform any actions, as the default run method only executes a Runnable target if one is provided during construction.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which attempts to start the MyThread instance. However, since MyThread does not override the run method, the thread will not execute any actions, thus not performing as expected. The fail assertion ensures that the test fails, highlighting the bug.
